scope: A user can explicitly review and select current approved, fact-linked story revisions for a saved-job resume. Preparation, page-fit preview, durable generation, download and history revalidate the selected profile/job/story/fact snapshot; exact user-authored wording and immutable revision/fact provenance are retained. Existing approved facts remain unchanged and manual review is required.

python_regressions.summary: 32 focused document, API, persistence, worker and page-fit integration tests passed.

connected_browser.summary: Two Chromium flows passed. Resume story selection remained explicit, the durable PREPARE request carried observed profile/job snapshots, exact story text and provenance survived worker generation and reload, and the browser made no external requests or submissions. Existing cover-letter story reuse passed alongside it.

frontend_tests.command: npm --prefix apps/web run test -- src/career-story-selection.test.tsx src/career-story-selection-review.test.tsx src/document-history.test.tsx
frontend_tests.summary: 24 tests passed, including unique accessible selector identifiers when resume and cover-letter pickers coexist, review controls and document-history validation.

frontend_build.summary: TypeScript check and Vite production build passed; the existing large-chunk advisory remains.

limitations: MJ-REF-002 and issue #372 remain OPEN/PARTIAL: story-bank import/edit/version breadth and interview-preparation reuse are not fully accepted by this slice.
The full repository suite, PostgreSQL and hosted verification were not run.
